title: NSS 78th Round Instruction Manual (Multiple Indicator Survey)
summary: Standard Operating Procedures for primary sampling units (FSUs), hamlet-group formation, household listing, and multiplier calculation in rural/urban sectors.
sampleContent: Chapter 1: Sampling Design and Estimation Procedure for NSS 78th Round. The first stage units (FSU) are the census villages in the rural sector and Urban Frame Survey (UFS) blocks in the urban sector. The sample allocation between rural and urban sectors is made in proportion to the population as per Census 2011. Within each stratum, FSUs are selected by circular systematic sampling with probability proportional to size (PPS). Multipliers are defined as the inverse of inclusion probabilities for each stage of selection.

title: Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) 2024 Guidelines & Scrutiny Rules
summary: Mandatory data validation, item-level scrutiny, depreciation computation, and gross capital formation aggregation rules for manufacturing establishments.
sampleContent: Section 2: Scrutiny and Validation Rules for Block E (Working Capital) and Block J (Outputs). Gross Value Added (GVA) from the industrial sector is computed as the total value of factory output minus total intermediate consumption. Depreciation must be computed using the straight-line method based on historical asset books. Any discrepancy exceeding 5% in fuel consumption to output ratios triggers an automated inspection memo.

title: Consumer Price Index (CPI Base 2012=100) Compilation Manual
summary: Laspeyres price index formula, geometric mean price aggregation, missing quote substitution protocols, and state-level weighting diagrams.
sampleContent: Methodology for CPI Compilation: The All-India Consumer Price Index measures the temporal change in consumer prices of a fixed basket of goods and services. Elementary price aggregates are calculated using the geometric mean (Jevons index) to eliminate index formula bias. Higher-level aggregations across commodity subgroups employ the modified Laspeyres formula with base-year consumption expenditure weights.

title: Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDPA 2023) Mandates for Statistical Fiduciaries
summary: Statutory privacy rules, anonymization benchmarks, pseudonymization of respondent records, and CERT-In audit logging protocols for national statistical registries.
sampleContent: Data Governance Directives under DPDP Act 2023: MoSPI and all subordinate statistical directorates operate as Data Fiduciaries. All primary survey microdata containing Personally Identifiable Information (PII) must undergo k-anonymity (k >= 5) and l-diversity transformations prior to public research distribution. Cloud telemetry must reside within sovereign Indian data centers.

title: Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) Activity Status Coding Standards
summary: Usual Principal and Subsidiary Status (UPSS) and Current Weekly Status (CWS) classification criteria for labour force participation rates.
sampleContent: Activity Status Categorization: The activity status of an individual is determined on the basis of activities pursued during the reference period. Under Usual Status, major time spent criteria (183+ days in the preceding 365 days) determines the Principal Activity Status. An individual spending 30 days or more in economic work outside principal status is credited with Subsidiary Activity Status.

title: System of National Accounts (SNA 2025) Gross Value Added Compilation Manual
summary: Macroeconomic accounting for digital platform services, intellectual property products, and Supply-Use Table (SUT) rebalancing.
sampleContent: SNA Macro Compilation Rules: Gross Value Added (GVA) at basic prices is defined as output valued at basic prices less intermediate consumption valued at purchasers' prices. For digital platforms, algorithmic matching services and data asset capitalization are recognized as intermediate inputs or intellectual property investments under updated institutional sector accounts.
